text_block_list.text:
"While waiting in the ready room
for the Satsuki Sho to get underway—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Ah! Fuji-senpai!
Sorry to bother you before your race!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine.
Was there some sort of problem?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, truth is...
we're all watching the Satsuki Sho together right now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to pass along everyone's cheers!
Do your best~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san will be just fine☆
I can't wait to see your wonderful show!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, you can totally do it, Fuji-san!
I know you can!
On the smartphone screen, countless Umamusume were shown.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... What an incredible surprise.
I was so shocked...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I won't run a race that would let you down.
After all, I am your dorm head!

Amid the shrill cheers echoing through the screens――
the Satsuki Sho has finally begun!
